ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 45% high-intensity white pixel distribution against a 55% low-intensity black background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense white mottling and irregular contiguous blobs localized on the distal lobes and along the trailing edges; the central region near the notch is primarily low-intensity black with sparse white circular clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated pixel-calculated internal angle of 60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated topography across the entire trailing edge with high-frequency variations in pixel-amplitude; most pronounced jaggedness on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve tapering to sharp distal tips with a symmetrical outward sweep from the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Ubiquitous distribution of roughly circular white high-contrast pixel clusters across the entire fluke surface, consistent with dense barnacle attachment scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear disruptions (rake marks) including a prominent long diagonal line crossing the mid-left lobe and several smaller intersecting lines on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks and dense circular barnacle scarring covering the majority of the visible ventral surface.
